# Clearing account (`clearing-account` v1)

An account at a CCP holding cleared trades and margin.

**Group:** Collateral and margin · **Mnemonic:** `CLR` · **Identifiers:** `CLR-…` in `accountId`

Open one with `CLR <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: clearing-account
version: 1
description: An account at a CCP holding cleared trades and margin.
match: { kind: clearing-account, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Collateral and margin · Clearing account, id: $.accountId }
strip:
  - { label: CCP, bind: $.ccpName }
  - { label: IM, bind: $.im, fmt: compact, emphasis: true }
  - { label: VM today, bind: $.vmToday, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - { label: Excess, bind: $.excess, fmt: compact }
panels:
  - id: trades
    kind: table
    title: Cleared trades
    key: F2
    rows: $.trades
    columns:
      - { label: Trade, bind: "@.tradeId" }
      - { label: Product, bind: "@.product" }
      - { label: Notional, bind: "@.notional", fmt: compact }
      - { label: Maturity, bind: "@.maturity", fmt: date }
      - { label: MTM, bind: "@.mtm", fmt: signed0, tone: sign, total: true }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.ccp, 'ccp')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
